title: Chapter 439 The Demon Tribe Takes Action
content:
Chapter 439 The Demon Tribe Takes Action

The Ice Phoenix Queen was also a little nervous at this time.

She wanted Wang Shuo to die, but she didn't want him to die, and she felt a little conflicted.

Just as she was thinking about it, Wang Shuo woke up.

There was an amazing aura all over his body.

He broke through to the advanced general.

But his injuries were not completely recovered.

He took out two drops of water of life and poured them into his mouth, and his injuries recovered quickly.

"Congratulations, Master, your strength has reached a higher level."

The Ice Phoenix Queen was shocked to see Wang Shuo wake up and his strength had surpassed hers, and hurriedly said.

Wang Shuo ignored the Ice Phoenix Queen, he just wanted revenge.

"You know which direction the Sword God escaped from!"

"I know!"

"Very good, let's chase!"

Wang Shuo stood on the Ice Phoenix Queen and flew quickly in one direction.

Now that the Sword God was seriously injured, Wang Shuo had a chance to beat him.

Wang Shuo thanked Master Zak again in his heart. If it weren't for this divine water, he didn't know how long he would have to heal his injuries.

But what annoyed Wang Shuo was that he searched in this direction for two whole days, but he did not find any trace of the Sword God.

"Your ability to escape is first-rate!"

Wang Shuo had to return in disappointment. The situation in Tiexue Ridge was quite delicate now.

War could break out at any time.

It had been several days since Wang Shuo heard the news of the Demon King's breakthrough.

But in Tiexue Ridge, although the situation was tense, the demons did not attack.

This made Wang Shuo a little puzzled.

So he sent a message through the chat group to ask Wang Zhu what the situation was now.

His spy had been lurking for too short a time, and had not yet found out any specific information.

As early as the last meeting, they had added each other as friends.

"Wang Junshou, I am not very clear about the true situation of the demons, but I guess they must be at war with the Roland Empire."

Wang Shuo also had the same idea, but no matter who won, it would not be a good thing for Wang Shuo and others.

The best situation is to maintain a peaceful state.

But the development of things was not what Wang Shuo could predict.

Half a month later, news came from the front.

The monsters won a tragic victory.

The border of the Roland Empire collapsed, and the Wagliang Empire took the opportunity to annex one-third of the territory of the Roland Empire.

The area of this territory is not small, almost more than twice the size of the Wagliang Empire.

The reason why the Roland Empire did not send a large army to reinforce was because a more dangerous war was taking place on another front of the Roland Empire.

The Demon King was also seriously injured in this battle, and two of the four Demon Kings were also injured.

But it was enough, one was responsible for defending the occupied area on the western front.

Another Demon King asked the Demon King to expand the western part, that is, the territory of Tiexueling.

The Demon King readily agreed.

The war with the demons was imminent.

When Wang Shuo got the news, he was also shocked.

He immediately withdrew the ordinary soldiers in the city to the inside of the Great Wall.

He also took the Hell Knights and 1,000 top generals to wait under the Great Wall.

Wang Shuo also planned to let these people see blood and try to fight the beasts head-on.

If they really couldn't hold on, they could still retreat to the Great Wall defense line at the speed of the cavalry.

After waiting for a few hours, the beasts arrived as expected.

Every time the demons attacked, they used low-level beasts as cannon fodder. Wang Shuo was very familiar with this.

Wang Shuo himself was already a high-level general. Even if he was trapped in the beast tide, he was not afraid. On the contrary, killing the beasts could increase his anger and facilitate a protracted war.

Therefore, Wang Shuo planned to stick in the beast tide like a nail.

As for the other generals, they could retreat to the city wall after charging a wave.

This was Wang Shuo's plan.

In the blink of an eye, the beasts surged over.
